name: IDatabase
doc: The core pluggable database interface supporting files, GSets, and ZSets with capacity bounds and heat configuration.

members.name: CreateFile
members.doc: Create a file at path with string value. Returns true if newly created.

members.name: ReadFile
members.doc: Read the string value of a file at path.

members.name: DeleteFile
members.doc: Delete a file at path. Returns true if the file was deleted.

members.name: CreateGSet
members.doc: Create a bounded grow-only set (G-Set) under path with a capacity limit and heat sink. Returns true if newly created.

members.name: AddToGSet
members.doc: Add an item to the G-Set at path. Returns true if newly added, emits heat if saturated.

members.name: CreateZSet
members.doc: Create a bounded Z-set under path with a capacity limit and heat sink. Returns true if newly created.

members.name: AddToZSet
members.doc: Add an item with weight to the Z-set at path. Emits heat if capacity is exceeded.
